declarations.name: AuiDashboardGrid
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI Dashboard Grid with projected item elements (`data-aui-item` on each child):
`<aui-dashboard-grid label="Overview" [(items)]="items" [editable]="editing">
   <aui-dashboard-widget data-aui-item="sales" title="Sales">...</aui-dashboard-widget>
 </aui-dashboard-grid>`.
The children stay Angular-managed; the grid positions them and, in edit mode, adds move
handles. `[(items)]` and `[(layouts)]` follow user moves and resizes.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Accessible name of the dashboard region (aria-label on the host). Non-empty.

inputs.name: breakpoints
inputs.description: { name, minWidth (CSS px of the host width, >= 0), columns (integer 1..48) }; unique names; one breakpoint must have minWidth 0.

inputs.name: editable
inputs.description: Edit mode: move handles, resize grips, keyboard moving, and undo/redo shortcuts.

inputs.name: reorderDom
inputs.description: Keep the item elements in visual reading order (row, then column) in the DOM, so focus order matches the layout. Focus is kept across reordering.

inputs.name: rowHeight
inputs.description: Row height in CSS px, integer 24..600.

inputs.name: gap
inputs.description: Gap between items in CSS px, integer 0..64.

inputs.name: compaction
inputs.description: 'vertical': items float up into free space (an item cannot rest below empty space); 'none': items stay where they are put.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Locale of the handle names and announcements.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: rtl mirrors ArrowLeft/ArrowRight moves and pointer column mapping.

models.name: items
models.description: Layout for the widest breakpoint: { id, x, y, w, h, minW?, minH?, maxW?, maxH?, locked?, label? } in column/row units (x, y integers >= 0; w, h integers >= 1; unique ids matching data-aui-item). Clamped to the column count. Narrower breakpoints derive from it unless `layouts` has one. Changing it with update() replaces every stored layout.

models.name: layouts
models.description: Saved layouts by breakpoint name (from the layouts getter or aui-layout-change detail.layouts). Entries for unknown breakpoint names are ignored; a layout for the widest breakpoint overrides `items`.

outputs.name: layoutChanged
outputs.description: Every layout change with its reason (move, resize, add, remove, undo, redo, set).

outputs.name: breakpointChange
outputs.description: The host width crossed into another breakpoint. Dispatched on the grid host.

methods.name: addItem
methods.signature: addItem(item: Omit<DashboardItem, "x" | "y"> & Partial<Pick<DashboardItem, "x" | "y">>, element?: HTMLElement | undefined): DashboardItem | undefined
methods.description: Add an item; `element` is the already rendered child (render it first, then add).

methods.name: removeItem
methods.signature: removeItem(id: string, removeElement?: boolean | undefined): void
methods.description: Remove an item from every layout; its element is removed too unless `removeElement` is false.

methods.name: undo
methods.description: Undo the last layout change; false when there is nothing to undo.

methods.name: redo
methods.description: Redo the last undone layout change; false when there is nothing to redo.

accessibility.pattern: Labelled region of items with a toggle-button move handle per item (keyboard drag-and-drop pattern, as Sortable List) and live-region announcements. No ARIA drag-and-drop attributes (aria-grabbed and aria-dropeffect are deprecated). The catalog is a labelled list of buttons.

limitations: Vertical compaction: an item cannot rest below empty space, and a full-width item cannot pass a half-width neighbor (it floats back); use compaction 'none' for free placement.
Collisions push items down only, never sideways.
Undo and redo cover geometry (moves, resizes, setLayout); they do not add back removed items or remove added ones.
In edit mode Ctrl/Cmd+Z, Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Z, and Ctrl/Cmd+Y are handled on the whole host, including text fields inside widgets.
Pointer grabs and drops are not announced; keyboard grabs, moves, resizes, drops, and cancels are (assertive).
The resize grip is pointer-only (aria-hidden); keyboard users resize with Shift+arrow keys on the move handle.
No auto-scroll while dragging near the viewport edge.
The breakpoint at create time uses host.clientWidth; a host that is not laid out yet starts at the narrowest breakpoint until the ResizeObserver reports its width.
update() with items, layouts, or breakpoints replaces all stored layouts.
Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.

declarations.name: AuiDashboardCatalog
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI Dashboard Catalog for a Dashboard Grid in the same template:
`<aui-dashboard-grid #board="auiDashboardGrid" ...>...</aui-dashboard-grid>
 <aui-dashboard-catalog label="Widgets" [templates]="templates" [grid]="board" (catalogAdded)="add($event)"></aui-dashboard-catalog>`.
`catalogAdded` receives the cancelable DOM event: render the widget for
`event.detail.item`, or call `event.preventDefault()` to veto. The catalog is created
when the grid exists and re-created when it changes.

inputs.name: grid
inputs.description: The grid that receives the widgets: a `#grid="auiDashboardGrid"` reference.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Accessible name of the catalog list.

inputs.name: templates
inputs.description: Widget templates offered by the catalog.

inputs.name: create
inputs.description: Render the widget element for a new item without Angular; usually leave it unset and render in `catalogAdded`.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Messages locale (defaults to the configured locale).

outputs.name: catalogAdded
outputs.description: A template was chosen (cancelable DOM event): render the widget for `event.detail.item`, or call `preventDefault()` to veto.
